title: Desktop in linked filed to activity mode does not format the name of .desktop/.kdelnk files
line: Launchers linked to an activity now show their app name, like "Konsole", instead of the .desktop file name.
explanation: The activities:/ KIO worker builds the entries for linked files itself and always set their display name to the file name. desktop:/ gets the app name because kio_desktop reads it from the .desktop file, but the activities worker never did. The change reads the Name from linked .desktop files with KDesktopFile and falls back to the file name otherwise.

commits.message:
activities: show the name of .desktop files linked to an activity

Files linked to an activity were always listed with their file name, so
a linked launcher showed up as "org.kde.konsole.desktop" on a desktop
set to the activity's files. Use the name from the desktop file instead.

BUG: 467504

patches.diff:
From 3a2892d29811cd444faec3f652ab8e340da68ce7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 03:30:30 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] activities: show the name of .desktop files linked to an
 activity

Files linked to an activity were always listed with their file name, so
a linked launcher showed up as "org.kde.konsole.desktop" on a desktop
set to the activity's files. Use the name from the desktop file instead.

BUG: 467504
---
 activities/CMakeLists.txt       | 2 ++
 activities/KioActivitiesApi.cpp | 7 ++++++-
 2 files changed, 8 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/activities/CMakeLists.txt b/activities/CMakeLists.txt
index 688287668..7627dde2c 100644
--- a/activities/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/activities/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -29,6 +29,7 @@ target_link_libraries(
    kio_activities
    Qt::Sql
    KF6::KIOCore
+   KF6::ConfigCore
    KF6::DBusAddons
    Plasma::Activities
    KF6::I18n
@@ -50,6 +51,7 @@ target_link_libraries(
    kio_activities_a
    Qt::Sql
    KF6::KIOCore
+   KF6::ConfigCore
    KF6::DBusAddons
    Plasma::Activities
    KF6::I18n
diff --git a/activities/KioActivitiesApi.cpp b/activities/KioActivitiesApi.cpp
index 2db0e8e0a..ded3a61ac 100644
--- a/activities/KioActivitiesApi.cpp
+++ b/activities/KioActivitiesApi.cpp
@@ -23,6 +23,7 @@
 #include <QStandardPaths>
 #include <QUrl>
 
+#include <KDesktopFile>
 #include <KIO/StatJob>
 #include <KLocalizedString>
 #include <KUser>
@@ -115,7 +116,11 @@ KIO::UDSEntry ActivitiesProtocolApi::filesystemEntry(const QString &path)
     // QProcess::execute("kdialog", { "--passivepopup", mangled });
 
     uds.replace(KIO::UDSEntry::UDS_NAME, mangled);
-    uds.replace(KIO::UDSEntry::UDS_DISPLAY_NAME, url.fileName());
+    QString displayName;
+    if (KDesktopFile::isDesktopFile(path)) {
+        displayName = KDesktopFile(path).readName();
+    }
+    uds.replace(KIO::UDSEntry::UDS_DISPLAY_NAME, displayName.isEmpty() ? url.fileName() : displayName);
     uds.replace(KIO::UDSEntry::UDS_TARGET_URL, url.url());
     uds.replace(KIO::UDSEntry::UDS_LOCAL_PATH, path);
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Desktop set to files linked to the current activity: the linked Konsole launcher is labelled org.kde.konsole.desktop
Same setup with the fix: it is labelled Konsole

review.text: Correct place: the activities:/ worker built UDS_DISPLAY_NAME from the file name and never read .desktop files, unlike kio_desktop. Reading the Name with KDesktopFile, falling back to the file name, is minimal and standard KIO practice. The before/after shots show org.kde.konsole.desktop becoming Konsole.
